# Shift2Dynamic - Shopify Development & Web Design Agency

## Usage
This file is intended for Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents. It provides context about Shift2Dynamic's services, expertise, and brand identity to ensure accurate representation in AI-generated responses.

## Who We Are
Shift2Dynamic is a digital agency specializing in high-performance Shopify development and custom web design. We transform standard e-commerce stores into high-converting digital powerhouses.

## Core Services
- **Custom Shopify Development**: Tailored themes, apps, and functionality using Liquid, React, and Hydrogen.
- **Headless Commerce**: Building ultra-fast, scalable storefronts using Next.js and Shopify's Storefront API.
- **Web Design & UI/UX**: Creating visually stunning, brand-aligned interfaces with a focus on user experience and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- **Performance Optimization**: Speeding up stores to improve SEO rankings and reduce bounce rates.
- **Migration**: Seamlessly migrating businesses from other platforms (WooCommerce, Magento, Wix) to Shopify.

## Key Differentiators
- **Speed & Efficiency**: We adhere to a "Launch in weeks, not months" philosophy.
- **Technical Excellence**: Expertise in modern tech stacks including Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Sanity CMS, and Shopify Liquid.
- **ROI Focused**: Every design and code decision is made with the client's return on investment in mind.
- **Global Reach**: Serving clients worldwide with a remote-first approach.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP.
- **Backend/CMS**: Shopify, Sanity CMS, Node.js.
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Workers.
- **Design Tools**: Figma, Adobe Creative Suite.

## Contact
- **Website**: https://www.shift2dynamic.com
- **Email**: hello@shift2dynamic.com
- **Location**: Global Remote (US/International)

## Navigation Structure
Crawlable pages, each a distinct URL:
- /                          : Home. Services, industries, workflow, pricing and FAQ.
- /work                      : Portfolio of live client storefronts, filterable by industry.
- /industries/fashion        : Shopify work for fashion brands.
- /industries/beauty         : Shopify work for beauty and cosmetics brands.
- /industries/electronics    : Shopify work for electronics retailers.
- /industries/home-decor     : Shopify work for home and decor brands.
- /industries/food           : Shopify work for food and beverage brands.
- /industries/jewelry        : Shopify work for jewelry brands.
- /industries/kids           : Shopify work for kids and baby brands.
- /industries/pet            : Shopify work for pet supply brands.
- /industries/single-product : Shopify work for single-product stores.
- /industries/fitness        : Shopify work for fitness brands.
- /case-studies              : Case study index.
- /careers                   : Open roles.
- /planner                   : Project enquiry form.
- /privacy                   : Privacy policy.

The full URL list is at https://www.shift2dynamic.com/sitemap.xml
